problems.source_says: The reported z and p values test one within-condition mean across all output pairs against a condition-label permutation distribution. Under the codebook definition, the unit for these reported tests is set (one condition's pool of outputs). Pairs supply the similarities and the Figure 6 distributions, but are not separate observations in the reported condition-level permutation tests.
problems.quote: For each condition, we compared the within-condition mean pairwise similarity to a permutation null built by shuffling condition labels 10,000 times
problems.locator: PDF p. 14 (journal p. 13), Section 4.5.5; PDF p. 21 (journal p. 20), Section 5.5; creativity-codebook.md, Section 6, Unit.

problems.form_value: Permutation null (condition labels shuffled 10,000 times across the 244 personas; between-condition baseline)
problems.source_says: The source distinguishes the label-shuffling permutation null used for inference from the between-condition baseline shown as a dashed line and used for descriptive cosine comparisons. It does not identify the printed between-condition baseline values as permutation-null means. The parenthetical equating the comparator with that baseline is unsupported; retain the permutation-null comparator and label the descriptive baseline separately. Numerical permutation-null means are unconfirmed (null).
problems.quote: The dashed grey line in each panel shows the between-condition baseline. Cells where the within-condition mean differs from the permutation null after Holm-Bonferroni correction (across four conditions) are described in the text.
problems.locator: PDF p. 22 (journal p. 21), Figure 6 caption; PDF p. 14, Section 4.5.5; PDF p. 21, Section 5.5.

problems.source_says: Descriptive richness is adjective-plus-adverb density, (n_adj + n_adv) / n_tokens, excluding punctuation. It measures neither lexical overlap nor type-token variety, the measures covered by lexical_overlap in the codebook. Being a word-count ratio does not establish that mapping. The form itself acknowledges that no measure code fits exactly; an exact supported measure code remains unconfirmed (null), while the formula and elaboration construct can be retained.
problems.quote: Descriptive richness, measured as the proportion of adjectives and adverbs in the text,
problems.locator: PDF p. 20 (journal p. 19), Section 5.4; PDF p. 14 (journal p. 13), Section 4.5.4 and displayed equation; creativity-codebook.md, Section 6, Measure.

confirmed: S1-O1 to S1-O3: three independent blinded external judges with relevant narrative/creative-writing backgrounds rated the submitted artifacts; these are output ratings, not self-reports. Locator: PDF p. 12 (journal p. 11), Section 4.5.

S1-O1: creativity is the sum of originality and appropriateness, each averaged over three raters; overall_creativity and participant are supported. The paper names this composite as primary. Locator: PDF pp. 9-10, Section 4.2; PDF p. 13, Section 4.5.1.
S1-O2: the 10-point originality rating assesses novelty in the participant's persona, supporting novelty, expert_raters, and participant. Locator: PDF pp. 12-13, Sections 4.5 and 4.5.1.
S1-O3: the 10-point appropriateness rating assesses fit to the gardening scenario, supporting usefulness, expert_raters, and participant. Locator: PDF pp. 12-13, Sections 4.5 and 4.5.1.

All five outcomes concern the session's persona/scenario outputs produced with AI available. The four non-diversity outcomes therefore answer with_ai; similarity answers across_people. There is no scored post-removal output. Locator: PDF pp. 11-14, Sections 4.4-4.5.5; PDF p. 26, Section 6.5; codebook Section 1.

S1-O4: embeddings compare different participants' outputs, separately for persona, scenario, and combined text, supporting diversity and embedding_similarity. Both named models, their 8,192-token limits, and maximum observed length of 2,235 tokens match. Locator: PDF p. 14, Section 4.5.5.

S1-O4: 10,000 condition-label shuffles, two-sided p values, and Holm correction across four conditions are explicit; higher similarity means lower diversity, as coded in the contrast directions. Locator: PDF p. 14, Section 4.5.5; PDF p. 21, Section 5.5.

S1-O5: the displayed formula is (n_adj + n_adv) / n_tokens, with punctuation excluded. The authors call it a proxy for elaboration of the artifact, supporting elaboration and a score per participant's output. Locator: PDF p. 14, Section 4.5.4 and equation; PDF p. 20, Section 5.4.

S1-O1: Table 1 exactly supports all recorded composite means, SDs, and arm counts: HLE 16.62 (2.90), n=60; ALP 15.92 (4.04), n=62; IC 17.57 (2.31), n=61; FD 15.99 (4.39), n=61; total 16.53 (3.56), N=244. Locator: PDF p. 10, Table 1.
S1-O1 to S1-O3: the recorded human-rating descriptive statistics, ICC .84 with CI [.80, .87], and Qwen validity correlations .71/.77/.78 match the source. Locator: PDF p. 15, Section 4.6.
S1-O1 to S1-O3: all recorded omnibus F values, degrees of freedom, p values, eta-squared values, and confidence intervals match the printed values. Locator: PDF p. 16, Section 5.1.1.

S1-O1 and S1-O3: the IC-versus-ALP means, SDs, differences, p values, and intervals match exactly, including the printed composite difference 1.64 despite rounded arm means. Locator: PDF p. 16, Section 5.1.2.

All 24 Figure 7 coefficients and their stars recorded for originality, appropriateness, composite creativity, and descriptive richness match the figure. The caption supports the stated sign convention and interpretation of unstarred cells. Locator: PDF p. 23, Figure 7 and Section 5.7.
S1-O2/S1-O3: Figure 4 contains bars without printed arm values. S1-O5: Figure 5 displays standard-error bars without numeric SE labels. Locator: PDF p. 16, Figure 4; PDF p. 21, Figure 5 and caption.

S1-O4: all recorded IC/ALP z values, adjusted p values, and descriptive cosine/baseline numbers match Section 5.5; HLE and FD nonsignificance is explicit. Locator: PDF p. 21, Section 5.5; PDF p. 22, Figure 6.

S1-O5: the four means, H(3)=19.06, p=.0003, Dunn p/r values, and richness-creativity correlation match. Figure 7 itself prints HLE-versus-ALP d=+0.06 despite text means 0.141 versus 0.142; the form faithfully preserves that source inconsistency. Locator: PDF p. 20, Section 5.4; PDF p. 23, Figure 7.

No additional eligible condition-level outcome was found: Qwen ratings serve as validation, DAT is baseline, and vocabulary diversity appears only in a message-length correlation with no defined metric or arm effect; these are already noted in the form. Locator: PDF p. 15, Section 4.6; PDF pp. 23-24, Section 5.8.

Omitted perceptions are self-reports; artifact counts and dialogue-act entropy are logged process measures, not a scored count of distinct ideas or diversity across people's final outputs. Locator: PDF pp. 13-14, Sections 4.5.2-4.5.3 and Table 2; PDF pp. 31-32, Appendices B-C.
summary: Output-based creativity and diversity measures satisfy criterion 3, and the recorded outcome numbers match the PDF. Coding problems concern the similarity analysis unit, its permutation-null versus between-condition baseline, and the descriptive-richness measure label.
